title: Command Menu
description: Renderless ⌘K command palette + generic search modal. Consumer-supplied groups + onSelect + label bag; slice owns dialog chrome, hotkey, and MRU history. Pulled UP from notion-page-clone's command-palette renderless surface (Wave N+3.7).

axes.description: Which mock command groups the palette renders — full set (pages + commands) vs commands only.

previews.seed: Palette rendered inline (open, no ⌘K) over 4-5 mock command items; type to fuzzy-filter. onSelect handlers are no-ops.
